widgets_values:
TIER 1 — GLASSES (RPi5) runs OFF-GRAPH.
Load its artifacts here: gray-filled video (real people fully covered), per-person masks, body-stick pose, canonical face-mesh.
GATE Tier1->2: no raw person pixels, no identity — the cloud never sees a real pixel.

person_count is now AUTO-derived from the loaded person masks (MIRAGEMaskPersonCount — needs the pending pod restart once).

TIER 2 — MOBILE (S25) runs OFF-GRAPH.
Load what the phone sends: the 2A cloud package (reference) and the reconstructed background (light-map source).
GATE Tier2->Cloud: person-region + pose + face-mesh only.

FIXES 2026-07-22: the unwired TIER2A_to_cloud display loader was removed — in deployment the gray-filled masked-frames input (TIER 1 group) IS Tier-2A's cloud package. light_map is now a MANUAL Tier-2 input (phone generates it); lightmap derivation and final assembly were removed from the cloud graph (phone-side work).

CLOUD — Reference Auto-Generation.
Builds synthetic character reference images from the Tier-1 silhouettes (identity-free).
Auto-ref (gpt-image-1) is BYPASSED as in V9 — the manual LoadImage refs are the active path.

CLOUD 2B1 — Character Generation (untrusted).
WanAnimate generates the FULL synthetic character from pose + face-mesh + refs.
Top band: Person A (RIGHT). Bottom band: Person B (LEFT) subgraph.
Inputs are gray-filled / identity-free only.

RETURN GATE — Cloud -> phone.
Only SYNTHETIC data crosses back: character videos (on black) and alpha mattes.
All writer prefixes are suffixed _CLOUDONLY (collision-free A/B vs V9).

Outputs: character_on_black + per-character synthetic_person/alpha (explicit matte, ALPHA_MATTE.md) + per-bystander BINARY MASK videos. 30 fps in, 30 fps out.
